adopt: Point it at your agent transcripts and see what your ten most-used commands cost.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Every agent stack claims its search/graph/memory tool is cheaper than grepping and re-reading files. Nobody measures it. The claim lives in a README or a code comment, measured once during development and gated by nothing — so a tool can regress into costing MORE than what it replaced and every signal stays green, because a tool that returns less looks identical to a tool that saves you something.

Install
pip install awtoll

Commands
  awtoll

Quick start
  pip install awtoll # zero dependencies
  pip install 'awtoll[exact]' # + tiktoken, for exact counts instead of estimates
  
  awtoll scan # toll table: what each tool shape cost
  awtoll repeats # toll you paid more than once
  awtoll versus 'awgraph callers foo' 'grep -rn foo.'
  awtoll check # gate: expensive shapes decided, waste ratcheting down

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awtoll/
synopsis: What every tool call costs you in context, measured from your own transcripts.
